name: Solena Brunch & Bar
description: All-day Mediterranean-inspired brunch, premium coffee, and cocktails in Corso Italia. Located next door to Savor Thai (1226 St Clair Ave W), same block. Dedicated vegan/plant-based menu options available. Private events: semi-private dining up to 20 seated, or full restaurant buyout up to 70 seated / 120 cocktail-style. Parties of 9+ must call to book. Parking: Corso Italia Parking Garage (~2 min walk) or 1-43 Norton Ave lot (~3 min walk).
